scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind insert text features.
Word processor: creates and edits text documents. Bold: makes important words stand out.
Alignment: positions text on the page. Clipboard: temporarily holds copied material. Spell check: helps find possible spelling mistakes.
Make a one-page paper example about your school or a Ghanaian festival. Include word processor, bold and alignment; present it clearly to a partner.
